scope: Reader-facing method identity and claim boundaries, extended to every published archived-real-QPU analytical raw, shot-scaled, affine, and log-affine variant. Historical IDs and artifacts remain immutable; CURRENT.json is intentionally unchanged.

classes.native: Official/public estimator is called and its native output semantics are retained.
classes.source_native_reimplementation: Public source code/data and source representation are used under a leakage-safe benchmark protocol.
classes.independent_reimplementation: Rebuilt from public paper/artifact information rather than an author runnable implementation.
classes.adaptation: Feature contract, representation, target context, split or execution setup is changed for a declared benchmark setting.
classes.analytical_proxy: A valid analytical or scheduled quantity whose clock differs from the target observation.
classes.unavailable: A required public artifact or input is missing; no surrogate may be silently substituted.
classes.baseline: Internal comparator, not a published-method replication.
classes.local_measurement: Native local engine measurement, not a published runtime-prediction method.

wave_1b_contract.native_rule: Within the Wave 1B analytical variants, only qiskit_estimate_duration_snapshot is native, and only for its unscaled single-shot API output. Shot scaling and every outer-train calibration are non-native adaptations.
wave_1b_contract.calibration_rule: Every affine/log-affine variant is an outer-train-only diagnostic adaptation; no outer-test labels may be used for fitting or selection.

qiskit_qcre_equivalence_semantics.single_shot: qcre_snapshot_critical_path and qiskit_estimate_duration_snapshot are numerically equivalent under the frozen Target to floating-point tolerance, but retain different provenance/fidelity classes.
qiskit_qcre_equivalence_semantics.shot_scaled: qcre_shot_scaled_schedule_seconds and qiskit_shot_scaled_schedule_seconds remain equivalent after multiplying their equivalent parent values by the same ledger shots.
qiskit_qcre_equivalence_semantics.calibrated: Matching affine or log-affine transformations preserve equivalence when fitted on the same outer-train rows. Equivalent rows are cross-checks, never independent leaderboard entries.
